short_delay: round32 nominal 1 or 3 ticks after target end
long_delay: 35 ticks after target end for decisions >=60; identical warmup
objective: pure MSE on common scored timepoints plus full-horizon activation cost / common count
interval: pointwise paired seed t95 (df23), Wilson event rates, horizon-capped event clocks; no adjustment for multiplicity
shadow: at eligible alarm denied by gate only, fit on already arrived rows, then compare frozen shadow and incumbent across next 10 decisions with >=5 scored in common; no cost or interference from subsequent updates; overlapping windows are not independent
complexity: ordinal engineering rubric: common references 1, crossed adaptive base 2, robust +1, confirmed +2, coverage gate +1, conservative min-label gate +1
pareto: per scenario observed mean MSE, update cost, capped recovery where applicable, and ordinal complexity; no universal ranking
